_comment: Highest number of high-severity advisories tolerated in production dependencies.
The security-audit workflow fails when the live count exceeds this, so a change that
introduces a new high-severity advisory is blocked while the existing backlog is not.
This number may only go down. When you remove advisories, lower it in the same PR so
the ceiling ratchets and the ground you gained cannot be lost again.
Any CRITICAL advisory fails the build outright, regardless of this baseline.
The backlog is concentrated in a handful of direct dependencies -- as of the last
review: axios, swagger-ui-react and @opentelemetry/sdk-node. Clearing it is a
dependency-upgrade exercise, not a config change.
NOTE: this counts distinct ADVISORIES, which is what the workflow measures.
pnpm's own summary line reports FINDINGS, which is higher (one advisory can be
